Senses of Void (sensesofvoid.app) — free, fast, browser-scored psychology
tests and personality tools with instant visual results and shareable cards.
No signup. Answers are scored on-device for privacy.

## Key pages
- Home: https://sensesofvoid.app/
- All tools: https://sensesofvoid.app/tools
- Free asset vault: https://sensesofvoid.app/vault
- Guides: https://sensesofvoid.app/guides
- Archetype library: https://sensesofvoid.app/archetypes
- IQ score meanings: https://sensesofvoid.app/iq-score

## Notes
- Results are for self-reflection and entertainment, not clinical diagnosis.
- Every tool ends with an HD share card; challenge links let friends compare.
